title: A Thorn for the Wolf Again
author: Coral Iversen
blurb: Bram Almeida, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
